name: FormMCP prompt
description: Type a task for an agent and watch it go through FormMCP: one family list, one app started, one result returned unchanged.

badge.label: Badge text
badge.default: One MCP connection to every Form app

intro.label: Intro
intro.default: is the one server you add. Agents see every FormAI app in one short list and load an app's own tools only when a task needs them.

styles.background-image: radial-gradient(circle at 1px 1px, color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 55%, transparent) 1px, transparent 1.6px)
styles.-webkit-mask-image: radial-gradient(circle 420px at var(--kx) var(--ky), #000 0, rgb(0 0 0 / 0.25) 60%, rgb(0 0 0 / 0.12) 100%)
styles.mask-image: radial-gradient(circle 420px at var(--kx) var(--ky), #000 0, rgb(0 0 0 / 0.25) 60%, rgb(0 0 0 / 0.12) 100%)

styles.background-image: radial-gradient(circle 300px at var(--kx) var(--ky), color-mix(in srgb, var(--hue) 11%, transparent), transparent), radial-gradient(ellipse 50% 36% at 50% 0, color-mix(in srgb, var(--hue) 12%, transparent), transparent)

styles.transition: border-color var(--dur) var(--ease-out), color var(--dur) var(--ease-out)

styles.background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--hue) 0%, var(--ink) 25%, var(--hue) 50%, var(--ink) 75%, var(--hue) 100%)

styles.transition: border-color var(--dur) var(--ease-out), background-color var(--dur) var(--ease-out)

styles.background: conic-gradient(from var(--kn-a), transparent 0deg, transparent 250deg, var(--ink) 310deg, var(--hue) 360deg)

styles.color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) calc((1 - var(--fw-v-%%http%%)) * 100%), var(--ink-soft))

styles.transition: transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1), box-shadow var(--dur) var(--ease-out), opacity var(--dur-fast) var(--ease-out)
max-height 0.7s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), opacity 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), margin 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), padding 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)

children.name: Echo text
children.text: Run /app_tools on @formcut and list what it can do

styles.transition: max-height 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), opacity 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), padding-bottom 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)

styles.border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--edge-strong) calc(var(--fw-v-%%d1%%) * 100%), transparent)

styles.transition: max-height 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), opacity 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), padding-bottom 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)

styles.border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--edge-strong) calc(var(--fw-v-%%d2%%) * 100%), transparent)

children.name: Text
children.text: Read the family list: one line per app, no tools loaded.

children.name: Text
children.text: Start only the app the task needs and list its tools.

children.name: Text
children.text: Run one tool and return the app's result unchanged.

styles.transition: max-height 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), opacity 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), padding-bottom 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)

styles.border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--edge-strong) calc(var(--fw-v-%%d3%%) * 100%), transparent)

styles.transition: max-height 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), opacity 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), padding-bottom 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)

styles.border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--edge-strong) calc(var(--fw-v-%%d4%%) * 100%), transparent)

styles.transition: max-height 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), opacity 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), padding-top 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)

children.name: Fine print
children.text: A scripted preview. Nothing is sent anywhere.
